Subject: Need help with a breach of contract case

Hello, my name is Arjun Shah. I am a 75-year-old pharmacist living in Nashik. Our company has a breach of contract claim of INR 7,00,00,000/- against Lotus Logistics Ltd, and the claim must be filed as a commercial suit. My case number is CS(COMM) 1742/2020 in the Nashik Commercial Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 78765 23184 or email arjun.shah@example.com.
